name: com.wgs.sdk.third.report.screen.ScreenActivityTwo
description: When BXM SDK selects its second lock-screen information layout, it opens after the device screen turns off and the configured delay passes. It shows clock, date and weather details with configured ad content and a web page.
disableEffect: This second lock-screen page, its information and ad links no longer appear, while the rest of the app remains available.
